meta.name: plantuml-skill
meta.description: Use when user requests diagrams, flowcharts, sequence diagrams, class diagrams, component diagrams, ER diagrams, architecture charts, or visualizations — including generating a diagram from existing source code, or rendering/extracting PlantUML embedded in a Markdown file to images (e.g. preparing docs for Confluence/Notion). Also use proactively when explaining systems with 3+ components, APIs, data flows, or class hierarchies. Generates .puml files and exports to PNG/SVG via Kroki API (no local install required).

copy.tagline: 从代码或描述自动生成图表，导出为图片
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要为系统文档绘制架构图或流程图
copy.tagline_en: Generate diagrams from code or descriptions, export as images
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to create architecture or flow diagrams for system documentation

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能根据你的描述生成 PlantUML 图表文件（.puml），并自动导出为 PNG 或 SVG 图片。它支持多种图表类型，如流程图、时序图、类图等。
howto.when: 当你要求画图（如“画个流程图”），或描述含 3 个以上组件的系统、API 流程、数据流时触发。

say.text: 帮我画一个用户登录的时序图。
say.note: Claude 会生成 .puml 文件并导出 PNG。

say.text: 根据这段代码生成类图。
say.note: Claude 会分析代码并绘制类图。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate PlantUML diagram files (.puml) from your description and export them as PNG or SVG images. It supports various diagram types like flowcharts, sequence diagrams, class diagrams, etc.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for a diagram (e.g., 'draw a flowchart'), or when describing a system with 3+ components, API flows, or data flows.

say_en.text: Draw a sequence diagram for user login.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a .puml file and export PNG.

say_en.text: Generate a class diagram from this code.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze the code and draw a class diagram.
